settings.refit: annually (January); labels must be fully known before the predicted year
settings.drawdown_basis: month-end closes of the risk asset (understates intra-month lows)

targets.label: P(drawdown worse than -20% within 12 months)
targets.verdict: no demonstrated skill: not better than the base rate - use the base rate

targets.label: P(drawdown worse than -10% within 6 months)
targets.verdict: no demonstrated skill: not better than the base rate - use the base rate

vol_forecast.target: next-month realized volatility (21 trading days), log

settings.var: 1-day 95%, filtered historical simulation (EWMA: normal); quantile of standardized returns of earlier out-of-sample forecasts (expanding window, >= 500 days)
settings.proxy: squared daily close-to-close returns of the risk asset
settings.epu: FRED USEPUINDXD, log 30-day mean, lagged one day
settings.epu_rule: keep EPU only if QLIKE improves with Diebold-Mariano t >= 2 at every horizon, under both the log (primary) and level specifications

short_term.epu_verdict: drop: no significant improvement from EPU (pre-set rule: improvement with DM t >= 2 at every horizon)
